Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider and the driver. Your dispute was over $4.00, and $2.00 of it is returned to the rider.

Route deviation — not established. The measurement that governs is the GPS trace, 13.65 km, not the trip record's rounded 13.7 km. Against the booked optimal of 13.0 km the excess is 0.65 km, or 5.0%, and POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be BOTH more than 0.8 km and more than 20% of optimal. Neither gate is passed, so no deviation exists, POL-RD-02 is never reached, and no distance or time refund is due. The driver's submissions on this point are accepted in full.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 2.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Rider advocate7 claim(s), 7 kept

  1. This dispute is filed by the RIDER and the fare ledger shows payment_status 'CHARGED' with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the $2.00 ERP line is still being carried by the rider and has not been returned.

    Read the whole claim

    A refund of that line is therefore a real remedy on this record, whereas NO_ACTION would leave the disputed charge standing against the filing party.

    EV-FARE-02815 · POL-GEN-03

  2. The one and only ERP line on this trip is 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry' at $2.00, and the driver's own 108-fix, 100%-coverage trace never comes near it: the nearest fix is 6,130.08 m from the gantry, far outside the 250 m radius by which POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace.

    Read the whole claim

    On that match test the vehicle never crossed this gantry at all, so the line is a billing-integrity failure refundable in full under POL-RD-09(4).

    EV-GPS-02815, EV-FARE-02815 · POL-RD-09

  3. The fare ledger itself flags the gantry 'on_optimal_route': false, and the trip record's own optimal route carries optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00 — the platform's own routing says the optimal route crosses no ERP gantry at all.

    Read the whole claim

    The off-optimal-route ERP total is $2.00 against an on-optimal-route total of $0.00. A $2.00 charge on a corridor the optimal route never uses, and which the trace never visits, is exactly the off-corridor pass-through POL-RD-09 exists to correct.

    EV-FARE-02815, EV-TRIP-02815 · POL-RD-09

  4. The rider does not need to prove a route deviation to recover the ERP line.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-01 provides that a billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4) is available whether or not a deviation exists, and on the governing trace figure the excess is only 0.65 km / 5.00% against the 0.8 km and 20% gates — so the ERP correction stands on its own footing either way.

    EV-GPS-02815 · POL-RD-01, POL-RD-09

  5. The driver's only answer on the record is that 'the ERP is charged by the system' — a bare assertion naming no evidence ID and no artifact showing the vehicle ever crossed the AYE Alexandra Rd gantry.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded; it cannot overcome a trace whose nearest approach to the charged gantry is 6,130.08 m.

    EV-GPS-02815 · POL-RD-08

  6. No traffic advisory covers this trip window: the bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02815-01, is admissibility MISSING, carries the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0, and has no payload, so it can be cited only for its absence.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-03 exoneration requires an advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses; with none on file there is no record-based justification for any off-corridor ERP charge.

    EV-ADVIS-02815-01 · POL-RD-03

  7. The correct disposition is a ruled refund, not a held file.

    Read the whole claim

    The unmatched gantry line is refunded under POL-RD-09(4), and POL-RD-09 provides that POL-RD-10(8) is not thereby triggered. Even if the driver's 'charged by the system' were read as an external-cause assertion, it names no advisory identifier, and under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged: the missing advisory (EV-ADVIS-02815-01, admissibility MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction within it. The rider should receive the $2.00 as a stand-alone billing-integrity correction, with the billing-integrity referral recorded alongside the money.

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider and the driver. Your dispute was over $4.00, and $2.00 of it is returned to the rider. Route deviation — not established. The measurement that governs is the GPS trace, 13.65 km, not the trip record's rounded 13.7 km. Against the booked optimal of 13.0 km the excess is 0.65 km, or 5.0%, and POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be BOTH more than 0.8 km and more than 20% of optimal. Neither gate is passed, so no deviation exists, POL-RD-02 is never reached, and no distance or time refund is due. The driver's submissions on this point are accepted in full. The ERP line — $2.00 refunded. The fare ledger carries a single ERP line, 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry', at $2.00. That gantry carries coordinates, and the driver's own trace (108 fixes, 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps) never comes within the 250 m match radius of it — the nearest fix is 6,130.08 m away, on a Yishun-to-Bishan trip that runs nowhere near the AYE. The vehicle never crossed this gantry. POL-RD-09(4) makes a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes a billing-integrity failure, refunded in full as a standalone correction and available whether or not a deviation exists. The rider's claim succeeds on this line and $2.00 is returned. The driver's statement that 'the ERP is charged by the system' names no evidence ID and no clause; under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and does not show a crossing. The rest of the $4.00 — the remaining $2.00 of the contested amount corresponds to no identified line of the fare breakdown, so it is not refunded. Figures used: charged_total $21.86; the refunded ERP line $2.00; optimal_route_erp_sgd $0.00; traced excess 0.65 km / 5.0%; amount contested $4.00. No escalation. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c); the trip identifiers all match; the only charge line with no counterpart in the trace is the one already refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-09 states does not trigger POL-RD-10(8); and no party has invoked the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02815-01 (admissibility MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) as an excuse — it is cited only for its absence, so POL-RD-13(1) and POL-RD-10(5) do not engage. The ruling rests on the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, both at weight 1.0, so it is not discounted on confidence. The POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral rides alongside the money and does not displace it. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

Rider, this ruling returns SGD 2.00 of the SGD 4.00 you contested, on billing integrity rather than on route deviation. — Route deviation: not established. Measured on the governing field (EV-GPS-02815.trace_distance_km = 13.65 km, which POL-RD-01 makes govern over the rounded trip-record 13.7 km), the excess over the booked optimal of 13.0 km is 0.65 km, or 5.0%. POL-RD-01 requires excess greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% of optimal; both must pass and neither does. No deviation exists, so POL-RD-02 never runs and the metered distance charge (10.28) and time charge (4.98) on EV-FARE-02815 stand. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes — 108 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps — so POL-RD-07 does not fire. — ERP line: this is where your claim succeeds. The fare breakdown carries one ERP line, 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry', SGD 2.00, charged at 12:47:55. The platform's own routing marks that gantry on_optimal_route = false with optimal-route ERP of 0.00, and the driver's trace never comes near it: the closest fix is 6,130.08 m away, against the 250 m radius by which POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace. The vehicle did not cross that gantry. Under POL-RD-09(4) a charge for a gantry the trace never passed is a billing-integrity failure, refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists. That is the SGD 2.00. The remaining SGD 2.00 of the SGD 4.00 you contested corresponds to no line on the fare breakdown and no artifact identifies it, so it cannot be returned; the refund is therefore partial. — Driver, your points are accepted: no deviation is established; POL-RD-02 does not run; your trailing-90-day record (deviation_flags_90d 0 over 388 completed trips, EV-DPROF-02815) means POL-RD-06 furnishes no uplift and no conduct referral, and the correction is confined to the pass-through lines. Your statement that 'the ERP is charged by the system' names no evidence ID and cannot show the vehicle ever crossed the gantry, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight against the trace. No traffic advisory covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02815-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing, and under POL-RD-13 the absence of an advisory no one cited is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction and not an escalation. — No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), the trip identifiers and timestamps agree across EV-TRIP-02815, EV-GPS-02815 and EV-FARE-02815, the refund is far below SGD 150.00, and the only unmatched charge line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-09 expressly excludes from POL-RD-10(8). The monetary effect is SGD 2.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. Draft 3 - sampled
Rider and Driver — this rules on the disputed charge on trip TRP-02815. Route deviation: none. POL-RD-01 provides that the trace figure governs and the rounded trip_record copy may not be cited; gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 13.65 km against a booked optimal of 13.0 km, an excess of 0.65 km and 5.00%. Both establishment tests must pass and neither does — 0.65 km is under the 0.8 km absolute gate and 5.00% is under the 20% proportional gate. No deviation is established, so POL-RD-02 never runs and no distance-or-time refund (base fare, distance charge 9.75, time charge 4.98) arises. The driver's first two claims are accepted on this point. ERP line: refunded in full, $2.00. The fare ledger carries exactly one ERP line: $2.00 for the 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry' (lat 1.366147, lng 103.754636). POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m as a crossing. The driver's own trace — 108 fixes, 100.0% coverage, 10-second sampling, zero gaps — comes no closer than 6,130.08 m. The vehicle never crossed this gantry, so the line is a billing-integrity failure under POL-RD-09(4), refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists, and recorded as a billing-integrity referral. Figures used: the money block's erp_lines total $2.00 (off_optimal_route_total $2.00; on_optimal_route_total $0.00), against charged_total $21.86. The driver's answer, 'The ERP is charged by the system', cites no evidence id and no artifact showing the gantry was crossed; under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight against the trace. It is not an external-traffic-cause assertion backed by an advisory, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged (POL-RD-13(1)), and the bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02815-01 (admissibility MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c); and the only unmatched charge line is the one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) excludes by its terms. The rider's claims that the case be ruled rather than held are accepted. POL-RD-06 is not consulted because no material deviation exists, and its trailing-90-day counters would not fire in any event (0 flags over 388 trips), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Outcome: of the $4.00 contested, $2.00 is returned — a PARTIAL_REFUND. The balance corresponds to no identified line on the fare breakdown and is not recoverable. The $2.00 monetary effect is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00 and executes automatically on issue. Both parties retain the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
To the rider and the driver: of the SGD 4.00 contested, SGD 2.00 is refunded and SGD 2.00 is not. Route deviation — not established. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02815), not the rounded trip record: trace_distance_km 13.65 km against the booked optimal 13.0 km gives an excess of only 0.65 km / 5.0%. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH gates to pass — more than 0.8 km AND more than 20% — and neither does. No deviation exists, so POL-RD-02 never runs and no distance or time refund (the fare ledger's distance charge 10.28 and time charge 4.98) is payable on a deviation theory. The driver's claims on this point are accepted, and the rider's own claim concedes the same figures. ERP charge — billing-integrity failure, refunded. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02815) carries exactly one ERP line: 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry', SGD 2.00, charged at 12:47:55, against a charged total of SGD 21.86. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m as a crossing; the nearest of the trace's 108 fixes is 6,130.08 m from the gantry, and the ledger itself flags the line on_optimal_route: false with off_optimal_route_total SGD 2.00 against on_optimal_route_total SGD 0.00 and the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00. The vehicle never crossed that gantry. Under POL-RD-09(4) that is a billing-integrity failure, refundable in full and available whether or not a deviation exists, so the SGD 2.00 is returned as a standalone correction and the billing-integrity referral above is recorded alongside it. The remaining SGD 2.00 of the SGD 4.00 contested corresponds to no line of the fare breakdown (21.86 = base 3.80 + distance 10.28 + time 4.98 + ERP 2.00 + platform fee 0.80), so it is not refunded. No escalation. Because the only unmatched line is the one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), POL-RD-10(8) is not engaged. The driver's answer, 'the ERP is charged by the system', cites no evidence ID and carries no weight under POL-RD-08. No traffic advisory covers this trip window — EV-ADVIS-02815-01 is admissibility MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — so POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable and nothing turns on an absent advisory here. Repeat-deviation check. POL-RD-06 does not fire: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 388 completed trips in 90 days (neither the count limb nor the ratio limb passes), and this trip's 0.65 km / 5.0% excess is not a MATERIAL deviation, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Confidence and execution. The deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-02815 and EV-FARE-02815, both at weight 1.0, and every artifact relied on above is unimpaired (the trace is 108 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) do not fire). Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect of SGD 2.00 is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
